 <div class="AboutText">
 Hi, I'm Dominic<br><br>
My enthusiasm for pharmacometrics comes from the fact that I can use all my knowledge and skills to the full. During my studies in pharmaceutical sciences at ETH Zurich, I gained not only insights into pharmacological, biological, and medical topics, but I got also trained in mathematical, statistical, and chemical subjects. In pharmacometrics, all of these areas help to perform analyses and develop pharmacometric models.<br><br>
 </div>

<p style="font-size: 1.2em;">
I love to solve problems by thinking not only inside- but also outside-of-the-box if necessary, analysing data, developing models and analysis workflows, and utilizing the analysis results and developed models to answer clinically relevant research questions.<br><br>
My curiosity allowed me to acquire skills and expertise in many areas and programming languages that I now would like to offer for your needs.<br><br>
